dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 08, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Dominant Performances Across MLB**

Toronto Blue Jays' Dylan Cease took the mound and threw a complete game shutout, striking out 11 and allowing just three walks in an 10-0 victory over the San Francisco Giants. Kazuma Okamoto led the Blue Jays' offense with two home runs and four RBIs.

In a high-scoring game, Chicago Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong hit two home runs and drove in two runs in a 9-7 win over the Baltimore Orioles. Tyler O'Neill also homered for the Orioles.

The Detroit Tigers' Troy Melton pitched a strong 5.1 innings, striking out nine and allowing no runs in a 6-1 victory over the Athletics. Spencer Torkelson homered and drove in three runs for the Tigers.

The Atlanta Braves' Jared Jones threw six shutout innings, striking out eight and allowing no hits in a 3-0 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Joey Bart homered for the Braves.

The Miami Marlins' Tyler Phillips earned the win in a 2-0 shutout over the Seattle Mariners. Xavier Edwards tripled and Otto Lopez scored for the Marlins.

The Tampa Bay Rays' Shane McClanahan pitched 6.1 scoreless innings, striking out five and allowing four hits in a 3-0 victory over the New York Yankees.

The Washington Nationals' Foster Griffin pitched a strong 7.0 innings, striking out nine and allowing one run in an 8-2 win over the Houston Astros. Luis García Jr. homered and drove in three runs for the Nationals.

The Los Angeles Angels' Samy Natera Jr. pitched 2.0 scoreless innings, striking out five and allowing no hits in a 13-1 victory over the Texas Rangers. Jo Adell homered and drove in five runs for the Angels.

The Los Angeles Dodgers' Gabriel Hughes pitched 6.0 innings, striking out seven and allowing three runs in a 4-3 win over the Colorado Rockies. Kyle Karros homered for the Dodgers.

The San Diego Padres' Michael King pitched 6.0 innings, striking out four and allowing one run in a 10-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks. Tommy Troy homered for the Padres.
